basic_details.job_title: MANIT Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal (मौलाना आजाद राष्ट्रीय प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान भोपाल) invites applications for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under the Madhya Pradesh Council of Science & Technology (MPCST) sponsored project titled "Design and Development of Artificial Intelligence based System for Depression Identification using Electroencephalogram Signals" initially for 1 year (extendable up to 2 years, co-terminus with the project) offering a monthly fellowship of Rs. 20,000/- without HRA to candida

how_to_apply: Candidates must submit their applications in both digital and physical modes before the closing date by following these steps:
Download the application form available on the official institute website www.manit.ac.in.
Fill out the application form completely with accurate personal details, academic qualifications, and research experience.
Prepare a detailed curriculum vitae along with attested photocopies of supporting documents, academic certificates, research experience certificates, and publication reprints (if any).
Email the completed application form along with all supporting documents to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] or [email protected] on or before 30 October 2026.
Place the signed hard copy of the application form and all enclosures into an envelope and superscribe it clearly: "(Application for JRF in MPCST-Government of Madhya Pradesh)".

Send the physical application packet to the following postal address so that it reaches on or before 30 October 2026: Dr. Varun Bajaj, (Principal Investigator) Associate Professor, Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal, 462003, India (Mobile: 9425156306).
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview. Incomplete applications or applications without supporting documents will be rejected. The post is created purely on a contract basis for the execution of the research project, and selected candidates will not be employees of the institute. Selected candidates will have no claim for any regular or part-time appointment in MANIT Bhopal. The appointment may be terminated at any time if research performance is found unsatisfactory. Canvassing in any form will lead to immediate disqualification of candidature.

Rs. 20,000/- per month (No HRA will be given)

content_sections.heading: About MANIT Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal is an Institute of National Importance located in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering is undertaking a specialized research initiative funded by the Madhya Pradesh Council of Science & Technology to design an artificial intelligence-based depression identification framework utilizing electroencephalogram signals.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following criteria as specified in the recruitment notification: Essential Educational Qualification: M. Tech. in CSE/ECE/IT or MCA or M. Sc. (CSE/IT) or allied branch relevant to the project with 1st class at both undergraduate (UG) and postgraduate (PG) levels. Preference: Preference will be given to candidates holding an M. Tech/MCA degree. Preference will also be given to candidates having good journal or conference papers and working experience in the field of machine learning and deep learning. Desirable Experience: Hands-on experience in modelling and simulation, Python, MATLAB, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Machine Learning (ML). Age Limit: Maximum 35 years on the last date of application submission. Candidates should verify their eligibility from the official notification for discipline-specific requirements.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a fellowship of Rs. 20,000/- per month as per applicable MPCST-Government of Madhya Pradesh norms. No House Rent Allowance (HRA) will be provided. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The appointment is initially for 1 year and may be extended further up to a maximum period of 2 years based on performance.

content_sections.heading: MANIT Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The position is a full-time assignment requiring fully devoted scientific manpower. According to the official notification, experimentation will involve: Python and MATLAB programming. Deep learning and machine learning.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MANIT Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their applications in both digital and physical modes before the closing date by following these steps: Download the application form available on the official institute website www.manit.ac.in. Fill out the application form completely with accurate personal details, academic qualifications, and research experience. Prepare a detailed curriculum vitae along with attested photocopies of supporting documents, academic certificates, research experience certificates, and publication reprints (if any). Email the completed application form along with all supporting documents to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] or [email protected] on or before 30 October 2026. Place the signed hard copy of the application form and all enclosures into an envelope and superscribe it clearly: "(Application for JRF in MPCST-Government of Madhya Pradesh)". Send the physical application packet to the following postal address so that it reaches on or before 30 October 2026: Dr. Varun Bajaj, (Principal Investigator) Associate Professor, Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal, 462003, India (Mobile: 9425156306).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled and signed application form in the prescribed format. Updated curriculum vitae (CV). Attested photocopies of all relevant mark sheets and degree certificates (10th, 12th, UG, PG, and any other relevant examinations). Proof of CGPA to percentage conversion formula (required at the time of interview). Copies of previous work experience certificates (if applicable). List and copies of top publications in journals or conferences. Contact details of at least two references (name, designation, institute address, mobile/telephone number, and email ID). Two recent passport-size photographs. Original educational, identity, and experience certificates for physical verification at the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the scrutiny of applications followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates: Shortlisting: Applications will be screened by the institute, and call letters will be sent strictly via email to the email IDs of shortlisted applicants. No physical call letters will be issued. Interview Schedule: The interview is scheduled to take place on 02 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. Interview Requirements: Shortlisted candidates must report for the interview with the completed application form, curriculum vitae, all relevant original certificates with a set of self-attested photocopies, and two passport-size photographs. Declaration of Result: The final result will be notified to the selected candidate directly through email.
